subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should this issue stay scoped to the remaining WhatsApp durable ingress replay fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, or should the operator drain/ack verb be split into a separate issue now?
rationale: The code bug has an open closing PR, but the report also asks for operator tooling and replay policy, which affects core/channel UX scope.

options.title: Keep Scoped To Replay Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until the bounded replay/dead-letter fix lands, then open a separate operator tooling follow-up if still desired.

options.title: Split Operator Tooling Now
options.body: Keep this issue for the replay bug and create a maintainer-owned follow-up for inspect/drain/ack UX before the fix PR lands.

options.title: Wait For Linked PR
options.body: Let GitHub close this issue through the linked PR only after that PR merges cleanly.

recommendation.title: Keep Scoped To Replay Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the bounded replay/dead-letter fix lands, then open a separate operator tooling follow-up if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: They already narrowed the issue after landing the run-lifecycle stack and can decide whether the remaining operator ask should split from the replay bug.
